decision.title: The processor and the XPath API (packet )

body.p: . src/processor.c, src/processor_internal.h, src/xpath.c, src/function_library_uri.c; tests , xpath.

item.p: Processor: one block holds the processor, name pool, type registry, item heap and the function library over every part (numeric, string, sequence, node, context, error, higher_order, map, array, json, uri); member requirements are queried with stand-in pointers (they only check for NULL). A null clock means sxml_system_clock (C17 timespec_get, civil date by Hinnant's algorithm); sxml_clock_read checks the whole reading contract (components, leap years, offsets) and the evaluator now reads through it. Parsed documents: arena trees from the processor's allocator with its tree and XML limits, no locations, destroyed with their last reference.

Limits (comments in processor.h fixed): both depths bound heap, not C stack (); 0 means 10,000 for maximum_expression_depth () and 1,000,000 for maximum_evaluation_depth (); new maximum_evaluation_step_count ().

Expressions: compile is sxml_xpath_compile with the processor's function table; identifiers of the static context are checked against the pool and registry (INVALID_ARGUMENT), the static base URI must have a scheme and is copied. Each evaluation allocates its own dynamic context, global slots (bound by name to the unit's globals) and document loader, and frees them before returning, so evaluations nest (tested through a host function body).

Document loader (per evaluation): fn:doc resolves its argument against the static base URI (sxml_uri_resolve, RFC 3986 5.2, now in src/xdm_internal.h over the resolver of src/xdm_node.c), then looks in the available documents, then the documents loaded so far, then asks the resolver; a resource that does not parse or a non-document node is FODC0002, the resolver's description goes into the error. fn:parse-xml makes a new tree per call (FODC0006).

Static base URI reaches functions through the dynamic context (sxml_evaluation_request.static_base_uri, sxml_dynamic_context_get_static_base_uri): fn:doc, fn:parse-xml (when no base-uri option), fn:json-to-xml (document base URI), and the new rows fn:static-base-uri and fn:resolve-uri (FONS0005, FORG0002). A function item called after its evaluation sees the caller's.

CLI: sxml xpath (docs/CLI.md): file resolver over the invocation's file reader (paths and file:// only), --param as xs:untypedAtomic exactly one, --method=adaptive the only choice; errors as expression:LINE:COLUMN: err:CODE: description. 19 golden tests.
tests/fuzz/fuzz_fixture.c names the json and uri parts too.
